name: CircuCity Marketplace
buyer_proposition: Shop unique, pre-loved and vintage items with confidence; earn EcoTokens rewards for circular purchases; track the CO2 saved.
seller_proposition: A dedicated channel for second-hand stores and sustainable brands to reach buyers of circular goods, with AI-assisted listing and rewards for participation.
fees: Seller participation modelled on fair marketplace fees; details in partnership docs.
co2_proposition: Every circular purchase avoids the CO2 impact of new production; shoppers can see the CO2 saved.
ecoTokens: Reward points earned by buying, selling and swapping sustainably on the platform.

models.buy: Buy unique pre-loved items from verified circular sellers.
models.sell: Sellers list inventory with AI help and reach circular buyers.
models.swap: Swap items to keep goods circulating.

cta: List your store on the CircuCity Marketplace
